Protester obstruction and the later reported official outward suspension are distinct mechanisms; no exact elapsed-hour count is certified. The endpoint concerns passengers and ordinary vehicles, not restored commercial freight. Dhehiba–Wazen was an alternative. The official UN PDF was unavailable in this round.
